Implemented scope

1. ANSWER_RESERVE_MIN=512 and the upstream reserve calculation cap the effective thinking budget after merged request/config defaults. Small max_new reserves at most half; budget is at least one token. No reserve is applied with no thinking budget or max_new<=0. The effective value is recorded in the existing per-request status thinking_budget field; request sampling is not mutated.
2. reasoning_repeat_coverage checks the last 2048 lowercased characters for periods 1..64 before the existing bounded passage/history detector. Existing opt-in stop/recovery policy and parser-boundary requirements remain.
3. KEEPALIVE_S=10 and a per-generation-pass last_out timer emit the existing ping event when token production produces no parser events. Existing engine heartbeat also updates last_out. Any actual parser event resets the timer. No extra inference request, token, or engine wait is introduced.
4. ENGINE_STALL_S defaults to 90 seconds (environment override, <=0 disables), with upstream CPU epsilon 0.5 s and I/O epsilon 1 MiB. Serial GEN queue-empty polls and the existing parallel control-reader polls use the watchdog. Any received protocol line clears its state. STOP/cancel paths bypass the watchdog and preserve their existing drain/timeout behavior. Waiting for free slots, sessions, vision, startup and slot-owned output readers are not newly terminated by this detector; the upstream admission warning/reaper was not substituted for this tree's existing slot lifecycle.

Watchdog safety adaptation

Upstream's missing callback / telemetry exception => idle behavior was intentionally replaced. Telemetry tracks publication time under its existing lock. gpu_activity returns None for absent, stale (>5 s), future, nonnumeric, boolean, nonfinite, negative or >100 utilization; strictly positive utilization means busy. No sampler/thread is created by the watchdog itself. Service.start_telemetry binds only actual StrataEngine instances to the same existing sampler. No telemetry API output schema changes.

Each silent poll checks GPU activity. Busy or unknown clears the CPU/I/O baseline and restarts the whole inactivity window. A fresh zero reading alone cannot terminate an engine that was observed busy earlier in that window. CPU/I/O sampling imports psutil lazily and fails open if unavailable/denied/exited. It reads only the currently held engine subprocess pid, checks Popen.poll before and after, checks ownership object stability, retains process create_time in comparable samples, and rejects decreasing counters or changed process identity. Termination uses the existing _silent only if the same owned child is still alive; no external pid, service, reset or performance setting is touched. A fresh-but-incorrect zero from a provider remains a telemetry limitation, so Main must review provider semantics before real admission. The ordinary existing engine_silence_s deadline remains authoritative when evidence is unknown.

Fixtures (not run)

The new CPU fake file exercises actual Service.run with small/large budget boundaries; periodic and nonperiodic reasoning text; actual held object tool arguments with progressing tokens and pings, versus normal content without pings. It exercises the actual watchdog for frozen, CPU active, I/O active, GPU active, missing callback/activity, callback error, process generation changes, and reset of the entire window after GPU activity. Actual _activity is tested with mocked psutil owned pid and unavailable/dead process. Serial generator close and serial polling cancellation exercise STOP and DONE drain. Parallel control cancellation verifies one STOP and bypasses watchdog during drain. Telemetry fixtures exercise fresh/stale/invalid/positive/zero values without constructing a real sampler.

Main qualification plan

Run python3 -m unittest serve.test_upstream_stream_recovery -v in the owned serialized host test environment, then existing reasoning_loop_recovery, reasoning_tools, server, queue_keepalive, ready_timeout, restart_waiters, parallel, nonfinite, Monitor and telemetry-related tests (use actual existing module names). Run the repository's mandatory no-new-finding Python/all-file lints and REUSE checks. Review the byte-token tool fixture against the actual parser's held-object behavior and adjust only if it exposes a real fixture mismatch. Review startup/restart preserving the bound telemetry callback and fake owner replacement/cancellation cases. No engine C++/CMake/build or GPU execution is necessary for these source-only fake tests. Any subsequent real watchdog check belongs to Main with fresh health/admission and the existing bounded owned process lifecycle.
